content.title: What are the requirements for becoming a Canadian citizen?
content.text: What are the requirements for becoming a Canadian citizen? To become a Canadian citizen, you must be a permanent resident have lived in Canada for 3 out of the last 5 years have filed your taxes, if you need to pass a test on your rights, responsibilities and knowledge of Canada prove your language skills Depending on your situation, there may be additional requirements.
